start:
In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Welcome to Natiq Quran Bot 📖✨

Your spiritual companion for daily Quranic engagement. Here are our features:

📅 *Scheduled Daily Deliveries*: Receive daily Quranic Ayahs or Pages in private chats, groups, and channels.
🎲 & 🔢 *Flexible Delivery Modes*: Choose between Random or Sequential (One-by-One by order) reading.
📜 *On-Demand Content*: Explore random Ayahs or Pages instantly anytime.
⏰ *Advanced Daily Settings*: Configure your local timezone, delivery time, content type (Ayah/Page), and toggle daily sending.
⚙️ *Admin & Group Controls*: Manage your groups, channels, and preferences effortlessly using /admin_settings.

Use the menu below to get started!
quran_menu_title:
📖 *Quran Menu*

Please choose an option below:
admin_only_buttons: ❌ Only group administrators can use these buttons.
help:
📖 *Help - Command List*

👤 *User Commands*
/start - Initialize the bot and view features
/random - Get a random Quran ayah
/randompage - Get a random Quran page
/dailysettings - Configure daily sending settings, time, timezone, and delivery mode
/admin_settings - Configure admin and group settings

🔐 *Superadmin Commands*
/superadmin - Admin dashboard, system stats, server & cache uptime
